An international consortium showcased an 8 000‑km hybrid network that combines quantum key distribution (QKD) with post‑quantum cryptography, linking European and U.S. sites at the SC26 conference. The demonstration proved that QKD can be integrated with scalable classical infrastructure to provide end‑to‑end security against both current and future quantum attacks. This effort marks a significant step toward global, long‑distance quantum‑safe communications.
